description: Raw per-draw benchmark run archives kept outside git. Each file is an asset of the GitHub release benchmark-raw-archives-1 of fcela/mboostrs; download it to `path` and run `python tools/benchmark_raw_archives.py --check`. `seeds` is [first, last, count]; `regenerate` writes a new archive that is compared with this one by `uncompressed_sha256`.

archives.regenerate: PYTHONPATH=python:. python benches/study_poisson_tuning_consistency.py --phase confirmation --variant baseline --panels low original high overdispersed zero_inflated --output /tmp/confirmation_baseline_all.jsonl.xz
